# Zyvibe

> Zyvibe is a website design and development studio. It designs and builds high-end custom websites, landing pages and SaaS front-ends for founders and businesses, and sends every new client a free working sample site within 24 hours of booking.

## How it works
1. Book a free spot at https://zyvibe.com/#book by answering five questions: name, email, company, what you are building, and your existing website or projects.
2. Within 24 hours, Zyvibe emails a private link to a working sample landing page designed for that business.
3. To launch, a one-time setup fee of $1,999 USD turns the sample into a finished website on the client's own domain. A $499 USD per month growth plan for ongoing design and development starts the month after launch.

## Services
- Custom website design and development
- Landing page design
- SaaS and product front-ends
- Website redesigns
- Search-ready builds: semantic markup, metadata, structured data and sitemaps

## Pricing
- Sample site: free
- Launch setup: $1,999 one-time
- Growth plan: $499 per month, from the month after launch

## Contact
Use the booking form at https://zyvibe.com/#book
